DLG-SC-LOC-033-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 棚の値札を見比べていらっしゃいますね。商品をお確かめしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're comparing the shelf labels. Would you like me to check the product?

DLG-SC-LOC-033-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この青い袋を買いたいのですが、下の値札には液体洗剤と書いてあって、同じ物か迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 青い粉洗剤の袋と液体洗剤と書かれた値札の食い違いを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to buy this blue bag, but the label underneath says liquid detergent, so I'm unsure whether it's the same item.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Point out the mismatch between the blue powder-detergent bag and the price label saying liquid detergent. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 袋の商品名は粉洗剤ですね。その値札は、隣の詰め替え用の商品に対応しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The product name on the bag says powder detergent. That price label corresponds to the refill product next to it.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では、粉洗剤の六百グラムに合う値札はどれか教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 六百グラムの粉洗剤に対応する値札を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then could you tell me which price label matches the six-hundred-gram powder detergent?
DLG-SC-LOC-033-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask which label corresponds to the six-hundred-gram powder detergent. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの札です。商品名と六百グラムの表示が、袋と一致しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: This one. The product name and six-hundred-gram marking match the bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この赤い表示は二袋買った場合の値段に見えますが、一袋でも安くなるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二袋価格の表示が一袋にも適用されるか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: This red sign looks like the price for buying two bags. Is one bag also discounted?
DLG-SC-LOC-033-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check whether the displayed two-bag price applies to one bag too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この表示は二袋での価格です。一袋の場合は、白い札の通常価格になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: This sign is the price for two bags. For one bag, the regular price on the white label applies.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 使い切れるかまだわからないので、通常価格で一袋だけにしておきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 使い切れる量を考えて通常価格の一袋を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'm not yet sure whether I'll use it all, so I'd like to get just one bag at the regular price.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Consider the amount you can use and choose one bag at the regular price. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 一袋ですね。棚から商品を取るときも、容量の表示をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: One bag, correct? Please check the quantity marking when taking the product from the shelf too.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 六百グラムの粉洗剤を一袋取って、レジでも商品名と金額を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 粉洗剤六百グラムを一袋取りレジで金額を確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take one bag of six-hundred-gram powder detergent and check the product name and amount at the checkout too.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Take one six-hundred-gram bag of powder detergent and check the price at checkout. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、ご不明な点があればお会計の前にお声がけください。お買い物をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. If anything is unclear, please ask before paying. Enjoy your shopping.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの紙について、どの部分をご確認になりたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which part of the paper you have would you like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-033-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 新しい部屋にこのごみの案内がありましたが、前の住人の物かもしれず、私の地域に合うか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 新居のごみ案内が自分の地域に合うか疑問を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I found this rubbish guide in my new room, but it may belong to the previous resident. I'd like to know whether it applies to my area.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your uncertainty about whether the rubbish guide in your new home applies to your area. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お住まいの地域名と、紙に書かれた地区名を照らし合わせましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's compare the name of your residential area with the district name on the paper.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 住所はこの欄の地域ですが、紙には隣の地区名が書かれているようです。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 住所の地域と案内にある隣地区の違いを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: My address is in the area in this field, but the paper seems to show the neighboring district's name.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the difference between your address area and the neighboring district in the guide. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 別の地区の案内かもしれませんね。正しい案内を受け取れる担当窓口をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: It may be a guide for another district. I'll show you the department where you can get the correct guide.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 缶を出す曜日を間違えたくないので、担当者には地区名から確認してもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 缶の収集曜日を地区名から確認してもらう希望を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I don't want to put cans out on the wrong weekday, so I'd like the person in charge to start by checking the district name.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want the can-collection weekday checked starting with the district name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その点をお伝えください。建物で決まった出し方があるかは、管理者にも確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please tell them that. You'll also need to check with the building manager whether the building has its own disposal arrangements.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 市の案内を聞いたあとで、置き場所と時間は建物の管理者にも尋ねます。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 市の収集案内と建物の置き場所や時間を分けて確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: After hearing the city's guidance, I'll ask the building manager about the location and time for putting rubbish out too.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check city collection guidance separately from the building's location and time arrangements. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、二つを区別しておくとよいですね。質問を書き出してから窓口へ向かわれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, it's good to keep those two separate. Will you write down your questions before going to the counter?

DLG-SC-LOC-033-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 地区の案内と缶の曜日をメモしたので、その二点を持って担当窓口へ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 地区名と缶の曜日をメモして担当窓口へ向かう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've noted down the district guide and the weekday for cans, so I'll take those two points to the relevant counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Note the district name and can weekday and go to the relevant counter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 窓口の場所をこの図でご案内します。いってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll show you the counter's location on this diagram. Have a good visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-09-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-09-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通知についてのご相談ですね。上の発行元の欄を拝見してもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-09-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're asking about a notice, correct? May I look at the issuer field at the top?

DLG-SC-LOC-033-09-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-09-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 税という字があったのでここへ来ましたが、この紙の発行元をよく読めませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-09-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 税の文字だけを見て通知の発行元を読まず来たことを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-09-001-SHARED-02.translation: I came here because I saw the character for tax, but I couldn't read the issuer on this paper properly.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-09-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you came after seeing only the tax character without reading the notice's issuer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-09-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-09-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この紙には市の担当部署が書かれています。ここで手続きを進める前に、そちらへ確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-09-001-SHARED-03.translation: This paper lists the responsible city department. Please check with them before proceeding with any procedure here.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-09-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-09-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 勤務先でもらった源泉徴収票も持ってきましたが、この通知とは別の書類なのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-09-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 源泉徴収票と市の通知が別の書類である理解を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-09-001-SHARED-04.translation: I've also brought the withholding tax certificate from my workplace, but that is a separate document from this notice, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-033-09-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm your understanding that the withholding certificate and city notice are separate documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-09-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-09-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、同じ扱いとは限りませんので、まず通知の件名と問い合わせ先を分けてメモしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-09-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. They are not necessarily handled the same way, so first note the notice's subject and contact details separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-09-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-09-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この件名を電話で読み上げるとき、漢字の読み方を教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-09-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 担当部署への電話で使う通知件名の漢字の読みを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-09-001-SHARED-06.translation: Could you tell me how to read the kanji in this subject when I read it out over the phone?
DLG-SC-LOC-033-09-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask how to read the kanji in the notice subject for a phone call to the department. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-09-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-09-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 読み方をお伝えしますので、余白に書いておくと電話で説明しやすくなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-09-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll tell you the reading. If you write it in the margin, it will be easier to explain by phone.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-09-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-09-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 余白に読み方を書けましたが、担当部署には通知番号も伝えたほうがよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-09-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 問い合わせ時に通知番号を伝える必要を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-09-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've written the reading in the margin. Should I also tell the department the notice number?
DLG-SC-LOC-033-09-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check whether you need to give the notice number when inquiring. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-09-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-09-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 通知に問い合わせ用の番号があれば、手元に用意しておくとよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-09-001-SHARED-09.translation: If the notice has a number for inquiries, it's good to have it ready.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-09-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-09-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 番号と件名を用意し、市の担当部署に、この紙について必要な対応を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-09-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 番号と件名を用意して市の担当部署に対応を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-09-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll prepare the number and subject and ask the responsible city department what I need to do about this paper.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-09-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Prepare the number and subject and ask the city department what action is needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-09-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-09-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 通知をお忘れにならないようにお持ちください。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-09-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please remember to take the notice with you. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-10-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-10-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご注文を伺います。量についてご質問がおありですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-10-001-SHARED-01.translation: May I take your order? Do you have a question about the portion?

DLG-SC-LOC-033-10-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-10-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: このラーメンを食べたいのですが、あまり量を食べられないので、麺を少なくできるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-10-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 小食のためラーメンの麺を減らせるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-10-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like this ramen, but I can't eat a large amount. I'd like to ask if you can reduce the noodles.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-10-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the ramen noodles can be reduced because you have a small appetite. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-10-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-10-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 麺は少なめにできますが、具は通常の量になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-10-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can give you fewer noodles, but the toppings will be the regular amount.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-10-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-10-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 具はそのままでよいので、麺だけ少なめにした場合の値段を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-10-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 具を変えず麺だけ少なくした場合の価格を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-10-001-SHARED-04.translation: The toppings are fine as they are. Please tell me the price if only the noodles are reduced.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-10-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask the price with fewer noodles but unchanged toppings. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-10-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-10-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 麺を減らしても値段は同じです。量を減らす注文でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-10-001-SHARED-05.translation: The price stays the same even with fewer noodles. Would you like to order a smaller portion?

DLG-SC-LOC-033-10-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-10-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 値段が同じなのはわかりましたが、食べ残しを減らしたいので、少なめでお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-10-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同額でも食べ残しを減らすため麺少なめを依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-10-001-SHARED-06.translation: I understand the price is the same, but I'd like to avoid leaving food, so fewer noodles, please.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-10-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request fewer noodles to reduce leftovers even at the same price. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-10-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-10-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。別の器へ取り分けるご予定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-10-001-SHARED-07.translation: Certainly. Are you planning to portion it into another bowl?

DLG-SC-LOC-033-10-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-10-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分一人で食べますので取り分けませんが、熱ければ少し待ってから食べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-10-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一人で食べ熱ければ待つため取り分け不要と答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-10-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll eat it by myself, so I won't split it. If it's hot, I'll wait a little before eating.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-10-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say no extra bowl is needed because you will eat alone and wait if it is hot. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-10-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-10-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、器も熱くなることがあります。飲み物のご注文はいかがですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-10-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, the bowl itself can be hot too. Would you like a drink?

DLG-SC-LOC-033-10-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-10-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 飲み物は追加せず、麺を少なめにしたラーメン一杯だけお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-10-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 飲み物を追加せず麺少なめの一杯を注文する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-10-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't add a drink. Just one ramen with fewer noodles, please.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-10-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Order one ramen with fewer noodles without adding a drink. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-10-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-10-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 麺少なめの一杯ですね。ありがとうございました、どうぞお席でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-10-001-SHARED-11.translation: One with fewer noodles, correct? Thank you. Please wait at your seat.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-11-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-11-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご注文の前に、材料について伺いたいことがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-11-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before ordering, is there anything you want to ask about the ingredients?

DLG-SC-LOC-033-11-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-11-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 卵のアレルギーがあるので、この揚げ物に卵が使われているか確認をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-11-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 卵アレルギーを理由に揚げ物の卵使用を確認してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-11-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have an egg allergy, so please check whether this fried dish uses eggs.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-11-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask them to check for egg in a fried dish because of your egg allergy. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-11-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-11-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 衣だけでなくソースにも入る場合がありますので、調理担当に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-11-001-SHARED-03.translation: Egg may be in the sauce as well as the coating, so I'll ask the kitchen staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-11-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-11-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 材料に入っていなくても、卵を使う料理と器具を共用しているか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-11-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 原材料以外に卵料理との器具共用を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-11-001-SHARED-04.translation: Even if it isn't an ingredient, I'd like to know whether utensils are shared with dishes that use eggs.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-11-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask about shared utensils with egg dishes as well as ingredients. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-11-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-11-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認したところ、器具の共用がないとは言い切れません。安全を保証することはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-11-001-SHARED-05.translation: I've checked, and we cannot rule out shared utensils. We cannot guarantee safety.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-11-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-11-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: その点が確かめられないなら、揚げ物は注文せずに見送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-11-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 共用が否定できないため揚げ物の注文を見送る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-11-001-SHARED-06.translation: If that cannot be confirmed, I won't order the fried dish.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-11-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not order the fried dish because shared utensils cannot be ruled out. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-11-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-11-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。別の料理も確認しますか、それとも今日は注文を控えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-11-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. Shall we check another dish, or will you refrain from ordering today?

DLG-SC-LOC-033-11-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-11-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ほかの料理についても判断する材料が足りないので、今日は食事を注文しないことにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-11-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別料理も判断材料不足のため食事全体を注文しないと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-11-001-SHARED-08.translation: There also isn't enough information for me to judge other dishes, so I've decided not to order a meal today.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-11-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide not to order any meal because there is insufficient information to judge the other dishes too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-11-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-11-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: かしこまりました。まだご注文は入っていませんので、このまま取り消しとして扱います。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-11-001-SHARED-09.translation: Certainly. We haven't entered an order yet, so we'll treat it as canceled without placing one.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-11-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-11-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 注文前に相談できて助かりましたので、友人に事情を説明して席を離れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-11-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 注文前に相談できたことを伝え友人に説明して退店する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-11-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'm glad I could ask before ordering. I'll explain the situation to my friend and leave the table.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-11-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you are glad you asked before ordering, explain to your friend, and leave. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-11-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-11-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご事情は承りました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-11-001-SHARED-11.translation: We understand your circumstances. Please take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-12-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-12-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お会計の明細はこちらです。内容をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-12-001-SHARED-01.translation: Here is the itemized bill. Please check the details.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-12-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-12-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この冷たいお茶は頼みましたが、結局テーブルに届かなかったので、金額を確認していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-12-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 注文した冷たいお茶が届かず会計に載ったことを申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-12-001-SHARED-02.translation: I ordered this cold tea, but it never arrived at the table. Could you check the charge?
DLG-SC-LOC-033-12-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that the cold tea you ordered was not served but is on the bill. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-12-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-12-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 届かなかったのですね。注文と提供の記録を調べますので、少しお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-12-001-SHARED-03.translation: It didn't arrive, then. Please wait a moment while I check the ordering and service records.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-12-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-12-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 食事の途中で一度お願いしましたが、そのあと追加の注文はしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-12-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 食事中に一度頼みその後追加していない経過を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-12-001-SHARED-04.translation: I asked for it once during the meal, but I didn't place any further orders after that.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-12-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you asked once during the meal and made no further orders afterwards. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-12-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-12-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 提供を確認できませんでしたので、お茶の分を取り消した明細をお出しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-12-001-SHARED-05.translation: We couldn't confirm it was served, so we'll give you a bill with the tea canceled.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-12-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-12-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 新しい明細ではお茶が消えましたが、二人で食べた料理はこの二品で合っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-12-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 修正明細からお茶が消え料理二品が合っていると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-12-001-SHARED-06.translation: The tea is gone from the new bill, and these two dishes are correct for what the two of us ate.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-12-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the corrected bill removes the tea and has the correct two dishes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-12-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-12-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。お支払いはまとめてなさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-12-001-SHARED-07.translation: Thank you. Will you be paying together?

DLG-SC-LOC-033-12-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-12-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は私がまとめて払うので、後で友人と分けられるよう明細の載ったレシートをください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-12-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分がまとめて払い後で分けるため明細付きレシートを依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-12-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll pay the whole amount today. Please give me an itemized receipt so I can split it with my friend later.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-12-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for an itemized receipt because you will pay together and split it later. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-12-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-12-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 明細付きのレシートをお渡しします。お支払い方法を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-12-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll give you an itemized receipt. How would you like to pay?

DLG-SC-LOC-033-12-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-12-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 現金で払いますので、訂正後の合計額をもう一度読み上げてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-12-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現金支払い前に訂正後の合計額の読み上げを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-12-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll pay cash. Please read out the corrected total once more.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-12-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask them to read out the corrected total before paying cash. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-12-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-12-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 訂正後の金額をお伝えしてお預かりします。ご来店ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-12-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll tell you the corrected amount and take your payment. Thank you for visiting.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-13-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-13-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 御朱印の受付はこちらです。御朱印帳はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-13-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is the goshuin calligraphy-seal reception. Do you have your seal book?

DLG-SC-LOC-033-13-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-13-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 手元の御朱印帳にお願いしたいのですが、この受付案内の「お預かり」の意味を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-13-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 御朱印帳を持参して受付表示のお預かりの意味を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-13-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like you to use the seal book I have, but could you explain what 'holding your book' means on this reception notice?
DLG-SC-LOC-033-13-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Bring your seal book and ask what the reception notice means by holding it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-13-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-13-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: すぐお渡しするのではなく、御朱印帳を預かって、あとで受け取っていただく意味です。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-13-001-SHARED-03.translation: It means we keep your seal book and you collect it later, rather than handing it back immediately.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-13-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-13-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 参拝している間に預けたいので、受け取りの目安を聞いてからお願いしてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-13-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 参拝中に預けられるよう受け取り目安を聞いてから依頼したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-13-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd like to leave it while visiting the temple. May I ask the estimated collection time before making the request?
DLG-SC-LOC-033-13-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you want to ask the estimated collection time before leaving it while visiting the temple. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-13-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-13-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、今の受付状況を確認して目安をお伝えします。お帰りの予定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-13-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. We'll check the current reception situation and give you an estimate. Do you have a planned departure time?

DLG-SC-LOC-033-13-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-13-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 三十分後には出発するため、間に合わないようなら今回はお願いせずに参拝だけにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-13-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 三十分後の出発に間に合わなければ御朱印を見送る条件を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-13-001-SHARED-06.translation: I leave in thirty minutes, so if it wouldn't be ready in time, I won't request the seal this time and will just visit the temple.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-13-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State that you will forgo the seal if it cannot be ready before your departure in thirty minutes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-13-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-13-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 出発時刻を踏まえて確認します。お預けになる場合は、控えをなくさないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-13-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check with your departure time in mind. If you leave the book, please don't lose the receipt slip.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-13-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-13-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 控えが必要なのですね、受け取る窓口は預ける場所と同じでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-13-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 控えの必要性を理解して受け取り窓口を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-13-001-SHARED-08.translation: So the slip is needed. Is the collection counter the same place as where I leave it?
DLG-SC-LOC-033-13-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Understand that the slip is needed and check the collection counter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-13-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-13-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受け取り口は案内表示でお確かめください。控えの内容も受付時に説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-13-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the collection point on the signs. We'll also explain the slip's details when accepting your book.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-13-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-13-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 先に所要時間を確認し、間に合う場合だけ預けて、控えを持って参拝します。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-13-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 所要時間が合う場合だけ御朱印帳を預け控えを携帯する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-13-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check the time needed first, leave it only if it fits my schedule, and take the slip with me while visiting the temple.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-13-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Leave the book only if the time needed suits your schedule and keep the slip with you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-13-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-13-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのようにご予定ください。どうぞ、お気をつけてご参拝ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-13-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please plan that way. Take care while you worship.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-14-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-14-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 待ち合わせの場所をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-14-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for a meeting place?

DLG-SC-LOC-033-14-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-14-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人に桃太郎像の前と伝えましたが、人が多くて、どちら側にいるか説明できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-14-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 像の前の混雑で待つ位置を説明できないと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-14-001-SHARED-02.translation: I told my friend in front of the Momotaro statue, but it's crowded and I can't explain which side I'm on.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-14-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the crowd in front of the statue makes it hard to describe where you are waiting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-14-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-14-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 像を目印にするなら、相手が来る方向も確かめると伝えやすいですよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-14-001-SHARED-03.translation: If you're using the statue as a landmark, checking which direction your friend is coming from can make it easier to explain.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-14-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-14-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 友人は駅から出てくるので、駅を背にしたときの右側と伝えればよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-14-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 駅を背にして右側という向きの伝え方を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-14-001-SHARED-04.translation: My friend will come out of the station. Should I say the right-hand side with the station behind you?
DLG-SC-LOC-033-14-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check how to describe the direction as right with the station behind you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-14-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-14-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その表現なら向きがわかりますね。ただ、通路の真ん中では待たないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-14-001-SHARED-05.translation: That wording makes the direction clear. But please don't wait in the middle of the walkway.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-14-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-14-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この脇へ移ってから、右側の通路から離れた所にいると電話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-14-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通路脇へ移動して場所を電話で伝えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-14-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll move to this side area first and call to say I'm on the right, away from the walkway.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-14-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will move to the side and explain the location by phone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-14-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-14-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、電話中も周囲を見てください。相手はお姿を知っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-14-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Please watch your surroundings while on the phone too. Does the other person know what you look like?

DLG-SC-LOC-033-14-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-14-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 初めて会うので、紺色の上着と灰色のかばんを持っていることも伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-14-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 初対面の友人へ紺の上着と灰色のかばんを目印に伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-14-001-SHARED-08.translation: We're meeting for the first time, so I'll also tell them I'm wearing a navy jacket and carrying a gray bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-14-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tell the friend you are meeting for the first time to look for a navy jacket and gray bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-14-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-14-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 服と荷物の特徴があると探しやすいですね。像から離れる場合は、場所の変更もお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-14-001-SHARED-09.translation: Clothing and bag details will make it easier to find you. If you move away from the statue, please also tell them the location has changed.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-14-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-14-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 友人には向きと服装を伝え、この脇で動かずに待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-14-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 向きと服装を知らせ同じ脇の場所で待つ計画を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-14-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll tell my friend the direction and my clothing and wait here at the side without moving.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-14-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will give the direction and clothing details and wait at the same side location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-14-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-14-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 無事に合流できますように。どうぞ、お気をつけてお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-14-001-SHARED-11.translation: I hope you meet up safely. Please take care while waiting.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-15-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-15-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お飲み物はこちらで召し上がりますか、お持ち帰りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-15-001-SHARED-01.translation: Will you have your drink here or take it away?

DLG-SC-LOC-033-15-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-15-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 温かいお茶を持ち帰りたいのですが、バスに乗るので、ふたが閉まる容器にできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-15-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: バス移動のため温かいお茶をふた付き容器で持ち帰りたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-15-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like warm tea to go, but I'll be taking a bus. Can it come in a container with a lid that closes?
DLG-SC-LOC-033-15-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for warm takeaway tea in a lidded container because you will travel by bus. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-15-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-15-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 持ち帰り用の容器をご案内できます。ただ、ふたがあっても傾けるとこぼれることがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-15-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can explain the takeaway containers. But even with a lid, it may spill if tilted.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-15-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-15-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: かばんには入れずに手で持ちますので、容器を持つときに熱くないかも教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-15-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 手で運ぶ容器の熱さと持ち方を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-15-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll carry it in my hand rather than put it in my bag. Please also tell me whether the container gets hot to hold.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-15-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask about the container's heat and how to hold it while carrying it by hand. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-15-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-15-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 熱く感じる場合がありますので、持ち方と付けられるカバーを確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-15-001-SHARED-05.translation: It may feel hot, so let's check how to hold it and what sleeve can be added.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-15-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-15-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: カバーを付けられるならお願いしたいですが、その料金も合計に入れて示してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-15-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 容器カバーの希望と料金を含む合計提示を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-15-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like a sleeve if one can be added. Could you show me the total including its cost too?
DLG-SC-LOC-033-15-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request a container sleeve and a total that includes its cost. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-15-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-15-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 追加料金の有無を確認して合計をお伝えします。お受け取りは今すぐでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-15-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check whether there is an extra charge and tell you the total. Will you collect it right away?

DLG-SC-LOC-033-15-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-15-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: バスまで十五分あるので、料金を確認してから注文し、出来上がりまでここで待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-15-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 十五分の余裕があり料金確認後に注文して店で待つと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-15-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have fifteen minutes before the bus. I'll check the cost before ordering, then wait here until it's ready.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-15-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you have fifteen minutes, will order after checking the cost, and will wait in the shop. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-15-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-15-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お待ちの間は番号札をお持ちください。受け取るときに内容を確かめていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-15-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please hold your numbered tag while waiting. Could you check the contents when collecting it?

DLG-SC-LOC-033-15-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-15-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 番号札と注文したお茶を照らし合わせ、ふたを確認してから持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-15-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 番号札と飲み物を照合しふたを確認して受け取る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-15-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll match the numbered tag to the tea I ordered and check the lid before taking it away.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-15-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Match the number tag and drink and check the lid when collecting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-15-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-15-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お受け取り後は容器を傾けないようにお持ちください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-15-001-SHARED-11.translation: After collecting it, please carry the container without tilting it. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-16-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-16-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この先の道は雨で濡れています。足元にご注意ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-16-001-SHARED-01.translation: The path ahead is wet from rain. Please watch your step.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-16-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-16-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 靴が滑りそうなので、散歩を続けずに入ってきた入口へ戻りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-16-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 滑りそうな靴を理由に散歩を切り上げ入口へ戻りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-16-001-SHARED-02.translation: My shoes seem likely to slip, so I'd like to stop the walk and return to the entrance where I came in.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-16-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to end the walk and return to the entrance because your shoes may slip. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-16-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-16-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 戻る場所を確かめましょう。どちらから園内へお入りになりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-16-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check where you're returning to. Which way did you enter the park?

DLG-SC-LOC-033-16-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-16-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 道路沿いの案内板のある入口から来ましたが、途中で一本違う道へ曲がりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-16-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 道路沿いの案内板から入り途中で道を曲がった経路を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-16-001-SHARED-04.translation: I came in at the entrance with the information board beside the road, but partway along I turned onto a different path.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-16-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you entered by the roadside information board and turned onto another path along the way. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-16-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-16-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この図の案内板でしょうか。ここから戻るなら、細い道へ入らずに入口の方向をたどれます。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-16-001-SHARED-05.translation: Is it the information board on this diagram? To return from here, you can follow the entrance direction without taking the narrow path.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-16-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-16-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 図に点線もありますが、濡れた道を避けるための近道だと思って通ってよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-16-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 案内図の点線を近道と判断してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-16-001-SHARED-06.translation: There is a dotted line on the map too. May I use it assuming it is a shortcut to avoid the wet path?
DLG-SC-LOC-033-16-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may interpret the dotted line on the map as a shortcut. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-16-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-16-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 点線の意味は凡例で確かめてください。近道とは限りませんので、表示のある道を使いましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-16-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check the key for what the dotted line means. It isn't necessarily a shortcut, so let's use the signed path.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-16-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-16-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 近道とは決めつけず、歩きやすい道を見てゆっくり戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-16-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 点線を近道と決めつけず歩きやすい道で戻ると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-16-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't assume it's a shortcut. I'll look for an easy-to-walk path and return slowly.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-16-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will return on an easy path without assuming the dotted line is a shortcut. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-16-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-16-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それがよいですね。途中で道がわからなくなったら、案内板の位置を確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-16-001-SHARED-09.translation: That's good. If you become unsure of the way, check where the information boards are.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-16-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-16-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 入口の案内板を目印にし、滑りやすい所では急がずに戻ることにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-16-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 入口の案内板を目印に滑る所では急がず戻る方針を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-16-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll use the entrance information board as my landmark and return without rushing on slippery sections.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-16-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will use the entrance information board as a landmark and avoid rushing on slippery ground. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-16-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-16-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 雨のあとは足元が変わりやすいので、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-16-001-SHARED-11.translation: Conditions underfoot can change after rain. Please take care on your way back.
